data_fields.name: button_release_point
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor; proposed 0.6 (not from donor)

best_idea: Dead-zone a stick once, in one place, against a player-tunable setting, then drive a button from an analog value with a press point, so virtual sticks on a phone get the same tuning.
decision_why: Take the single dead-zone point with a player setting and the analog-to-button step. Change the donor's per-axis dead zone to a radial one with rescale (the donor leaves a jump at the edge), and add a release point below the press point. No phone touch code exists in this donor.
acceptance: On a 375-wide phone, a virtual stick held inside 12.5 percent of its radius moves the hero zero; just outside that zone the speed starts near zero and rises smoothly to full at the rim. A trigger-style button does not flicker when the value hovers at its press point.
